items.name: Da capo architecture

items.name: Sequences that build dramatic momentum
items.description: Sequences (usually descending thirds or circle of fifths) used not just for development but for emotional buildup toward a climax. The sequence intensifies; the resolution releases.

items.name: Dramatic contrast between major and minor
items.description: Handel shifts between parallel major and minor (C major → C minor) for dramatic effect in a way Bach typically does not. A joyful section turning to minor for a sudden shadow, then returning to major
